ctx.x: Johnny was a black faced comedian which was the kind of act presented by Al Jolson and Eddie Cantor. But "Banjo" was a light brown skin Negro and did a pantomine act of a singer which was original and amusing. A trumpet player would stand on stage near the wings and use a plunger to get a wa-wa effect which coincided with the lip movements that "Banjo" did in his impressions of a person singing a song. I had not known him personally until we met at the Honcho House. We were together quite often in Tokyo, and I…

The 25th of May 1946, we received the last oversea pay which was 375 yens that was equal to 25 dollars, the part of the salary we received each week away from home. May the 31st, we boarded the s.s. 'Marine Serpent', another military transport ship for home. I had visited Kamakura not far from Tokyo and saw the largest statue of Buddha in Japan. I was happy to have spent some time in Tokyo, but there was a certain joy in knowing that in a couple of weeks I would be back in the Apple again.
